args:
epoch_seconds="$(date +%s)"
utc="$(date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')"
printf 'SKIFF_LIFECYCLE_POD epoch_seconds=%s utc=%s node=%s pod=%s\n' \
  "$epoch_seconds" "$utc" "$NODE_NAME" "$POD_NAME"
touch /tmp/timestamp-printed
trap 'exit 0' TERM INT
while :; do
  sleep 3600 &
  wait "$!"
done
